snippet.title: Trials of Arise
snippet.description:
Face off against the monstrous Hildegun, and its deadly minions: Elyraq, Grande, and Naklokhan, while battling rival players who want the loot for themselves. Conquer the chaos, claim rare crafting materials, and forge powerful new weapons and items that will upgrade your character.

Join Trials of Arise… will you rise above the carnage? 🔥
